title: Radar sites built 1946, plus Mori Arti and Continental bases
summary: Jesse Michels tells of Radar sites built 1946, plus Mori Arti and Continental bases, about 1946-1951 at New Mexico (no place named), and frames it as the host. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: When Scott dug into it, he found out the site was originally built in 1946 before being moved in 1950. He also [music] found two other bases close by, Mori Arti and Continental, although those weren't active until around 1950 or 51.

plain: A podcast host, Jesse Michels, says that a researcher named Scott Ramsay, looking into a claimed crash of a craft carrying alien bodies in New Mexico, found that a nearby radar site was first built in 1946 and then moved in 1950. Michels says Ramsay also found two other bases close by, called Mori Arti and Continental, though they were not active until around 1950 or 1951. The point is that radar in the area could have tracked a crash there.
